meta.title: {app} — Free random video chat with people worldwide
meta.description: Meet new people from all over the world in seconds. Free random video and text chat, in your language.
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Say hi to the *world*.
hero.subtitle: Meet new people from every corner of the planet in one tap. Free, friendly, and in your language.
interests.label: Your interests
interests.hint: We'll try to match you with someone who likes the same things.
filter.sameLanguage: Only match people who speak English
feature.safe.title: Safety first
feature.safe.text: Skip or report anyone in one tap. Zero tolerance for abuse.

chat.connectedUnknown: You're now chatting with a stranger. Say hi!
chat.failed: Couldn't connect to this person. Finding someone else…
chat.linksBlocked: Links aren't allowed, to keep everyone safe.
self.label: You
report.title: Report this person
report.text: Reports are anonymous. The chat ends right away and you won't be matched with them again.
report.thanks: Thanks for reporting. We'll review it.
report.none: There's nobody to report right now.
settings.title: Settings
settings.blur: Blur new people's video until I tap
media.title: Allow camera and microphone
media.text: Your browser will ask for permission. Your video goes straight to the person you're talking to.
media.denied.title: Camera access is blocked
media.denied.text: Allow the camera and microphone in your browser settings (look for the camera icon in the address bar), then try again.
media.notFound: We couldn't find a camera or microphone on this device.
media.inUse: Your camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
error.banned.title: You're temporarily blocked
error.banned.text: Several people reported you for breaking our Community Guidelines. You can come back on {time}.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support video chat. Please use the latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
error.insecure: Video chat only works on a secure (https://) connection.
error.noscript: {app} needs JavaScript to work. Please enable it in your browser.
showcase.eyebrow: A new way to say hi
showcase.title: Real faces. *Real conversations.*
showcase.text: Video or text, on your phone or computer. Every time you tap Next you meet someone new — matched by interests and language, wherever they are.
steps.title: Say hi in *three steps*
steps.1.title: Sign in
steps.1.text: Use Google or your email. It keeps trolls out — and strangers never see your name.
steps.2.title: Agree to the rules
steps.2.text: Confirm you're 18+ and promise to be kind. That's it.
steps.3.title: Press start
steps.3.text: Check your camera, add interests if you like, and meet someone new in seconds.
safety.title: Built to keep chats *friendly*.
safety.text: Every feature is designed to keep you in control of who you see and what you share.
safety.report.title: Report in one tap
safety.report.text: Flag anyone instantly — even someone you just skipped. You'll never be matched again.
safety.blur.title: Blur new faces
safety.blur.text: Turn on blur and decide when to reveal a stranger's video.
safety.bans.title: Repeat offenders blocked
safety.bans.text: Accounts reported by several people are blocked automatically.
safety.spam.title: No links, no spam
safety.spam.text: Links are blocked in chat, so scammers and bots have nothing to sell.
world.title: Find your people, *anywhere*.
world.text: Add interests to meet people who love the same things — from music and anime to football or practicing a new language. {app} speaks 12 languages.
cta.title: Start a random chat now
faq.title: Questions? *Answers.*
faq.a1: Yes. Video and text chat are completely free.
faq.q2: Why do I need to sign in?
faq.a2: Accounts keep bots and trolls out and make reports count. Other people never see your name or email — only your country flag.
faq.a3: You can skip or report anyone instantly and blur new faces, and people who break the rules get blocked. Never share personal details with strangers.
faq.q4: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a4: Yes. It runs in any modern browser on Android, iPhone, Windows and Mac — no app needed.
faq.a5: Adults aged 18 or older who agree to our Community Guidelines.
